task: Core 1186 U05: enforce Pro-only Digital Office direct server actions and preserve Alap normal transactional support email

assuranceCeiling.rationale: These are consequential remotely callable tenant Server Actions. The selected adversarial, pairwise, state, fault and finite-state tests cover Alap-versus-Pro authorization, permission/tenant failure combinations and preserved Alap transactional email, while remaining limited to direct Office Server Actions; API and storage closure are deferred to U06.

acceptanceCriteria: All functions gated by supportAccess() require officeCommunicationAdvanced unconditionally, not only when options.advanced is true.
Every composer draft/create/send/autosave action calls access() which performs the Pro entitlement check before tenant scope or mutations.
The markCustomerThreadReadAction customer-read helper performs the Pro entitlement check before database mutation.
Alap may not access the direct Digital Office actions even if manually invoking the Server Actions or bypassing admin layout.
Alap retains hasPlanFeature(alap,support) and officeCommunication; Alap officeCommunicationAdvanced is false and Pro true, with transactional notification sender modules unchanged.
Team Chat continues to be governed by teamChat, and U06 HTTP/API/storage work stays PARTIAL until separate proof.
Negative tests, exact-head tests/TypeScript/production build, Customer Baseline and Control Plane Truth/Lifecycle must pass; no suppression of unrelated gates.
Legacy internal-chat regression must assert the new unconditional Pro gate for direct Digital Office actions without narrowing support.manage RBAC or Team Chat.

Sentinel proof semantics PASS: authorization and plan separation claims are backed by actual supported GUARD-QUALITY-TESTS behavioral-proof, scope, forbidden-state and regression dimensions, not invented evidence dimensions.
invariants: Authorization must be enforced on the server at the shared access helper, before tenant scope and createAdminClient operations.
No feature entitlement is inserted, deleted or changed; existing RLS and RBAC remain required.
Keep Pro Digital Office route shell protection (U04) and independent Alap commerce e-mail pipeline intact.
Failure must occur before any write, draft, send or read acknowledgement on Alap.
forbiddenStates: Office supportAccess has a branch where officeCommunicationAdvanced is never checked.
Office composer access or customer read access can proceed with an Alap entitlement.
Changing the core officeCommunication grant or disabling Alap normal support/commerce e-mails.
Treating inherited route layout as authorization proof for directly callable Server Actions.
Marking #1186 full Digital Office boundary DONE while direct HTTP APIs and database/storage are unverified.

failureModes: Direct Server Action call bypasses the protected Next.js layout
Old optional advanced check permits Alap shared inbox mutations
Composer autosave or send bypasses the main Office action helper
Customer read acknowledgement leaks conversation activity to Alap
Plan entitlement incorrectly narrowed globally and breaks normal purchase emails
Team chat guard accidentally replaced by officeCommunicationAdvanced
Unknown direct action import path escapes the access helper
edgeCases: Server Action called from forged client without rendering layout
Alap support.manage RBAC exists but advanced plan entitlement is absent
Pro owner has required plan but lacks support.manage role
Tenant-context mismatch or stale plan capabilities
Repeated draft autosave or race during downgrade from Pro to Alap
Normal order confirmation email on Alap must remain functional
Team Chat still checked only under its separate plan access helper

specialistReviews.resolution: Require advanced Pro before the tenant-scope or Supabase data operations.

specialistReviews.resolution: Scope the Pro gate only to Digital Office access helpers, preserve plan catalog and transactional commerce services, and prove with negative assertions.

specialistReviews.finding: Three shared helpers govern the directly callable server-side Office actions and customer read handler.
specialistReviews.resolution: Gate these helpers so all current Office callers inherit the boundary; do not alter Team Chat.

specialistReviews.finding: HTTP API attachment routes remain an independent backend attack surface, so U05 closure must not overclaim full #1186.
specialistReviews.resolution: Declare U06 prerequisite, retain parent issue OPEN/PARTIAL and preserve Control Plane evidence constraints.

semanticExecutionRoute.request: Core 1186 U05: enforce Pro-only Digital Office direct server actions and preserve Alap normal transactional support email

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The Pro-only shared Digital Office route cannot protect directly invoked Next.js server actions. Office e-mail/thread/composer/read actions still accept the Alap officeCommunication entitlement, despite the product decision that the Digital Office workspace is Pro-only. Keep Alap commercial transactional emails and standard support independently available.
observableOutcomes: Direct Digital Office support, inbox, composer and customer-read server actions all enforce the canonical officeCommunicationAdvanced Pro entitlement before resolving tenant scope or touching the database.
Normal Alap support capability and transactional order/customer e-mails remain available through their independent commerce/notification pathways.
Team Chat preserves its existing separate teamChat Pro gate; the subsequent email attachment API work remains open in U06.
unresolvedRisks: Server Action can be invoked without rendering or inheriting the parent layout, so route-only checks are insufficient.
Generic officeCommunication supports Alap and must not be globally reclassified to Pro, because Alap transactional notifications and standard support depend on it.
Other API/RPC/storage entrypoints are intentionally excluded and must not be declared closed after this unit.

Change Team Chat and existing Pro-only hub guards

Close parent issue #1186 or claim complete Digital Office authorization
